name: gauntlet-loop
description: Iteratively improve a product or artifact against an inspectable quality bar using sequential rounds, blind A/B comparison, one-gap-at-a-time fixes and disk-backed state.

interface.longDescription: Run a sequential quality loop: build or capture the deliverable, compare it blindly against a concrete bar, commit the verdict before reveal, fix the single largest gap, and repeat. Supports games, apps, UI, images, 3D, video, text and code.
defaultPrompt: Run a gauntlet loop against this reference.
Keep improving this until it beats the quality bar.
Polish this game against these screenshots.
